locator: 草千里ヶ浜 section: double craters of 500 m and 1 km diameter; later ash fills between the inner crater and western outer rim
formationRelations: Later volcanic ash fills the area between the inner crater and the western rim of the outer crater
The north-south ridge in the central grassland is the western rim of the inner crater
The southern end of that ridge is a remnant of a destroyed lava dome
